# Northbeam Support and SLA

## Enterprise SLA

The Enterprise plan guarantees 99.9% uptime. For P1 (critical) issues,
Enterprise customers receive a 1-hour response time. Enterprise support
is available 24/7 by phone at +1-800-555-NBEM, through a priority email
queue, and optionally via Slack Connect.

## Standard Support Tier

The standard support tier (Free and Pro plans) guarantees 99.5% uptime.
Critical issues receive a 24-hour response time. Support is available by
email only, during business hours.

## Cancellation Policies by Plan

Free plan: cancel anytime, no charges, no notice required.

Pro plan: monthly cancellations take effect at the end of the billing
period; annual cancellations require 30 days' notice and are pro-rated.

Enterprise plan: cancellations require 90 days' notice, and
contract-specific terms may apply.
